title: A third of the way through my month long theatre marathon! #greatthea...
transcript: Welcome to the great theatre Adventure Day 10 The first day of Broadway Con! Broadway Con is one of my favorite events every year where Broadway fans and Broadway professionals come together for three days of panels and performances and just a ton of fun. Like, where else could I see two of the writers of one of my favorite musicals of all time, followed by one of my friends moderating their own panel and then following that up with performances from new and up humming Broadway shows like only at Broadway Con. I also love strolling the booths at Broadway Con, even if my wallet does not. I'm a huge fan of Broadway art and Broadway pins and stickers, and you can get literally all of that at the marketplace. And if you're going to Broadway Con on Sunday, check out the Tony Awards panel that I'll be a part of. After the con was over for the day, I did have time to go see a show, but I had nothing planned so I looked for some last minute discounts and ended up getting a last minute rush to someone spectacular. It was a perfect first day of Broadway Con and I can't wait for the rest of the weekend. Ay!
classificationReason: BroadwayCon recap covering multiple panels and performances, mentions 'someone spectacular' but unclear which specific show from list
